name: knowledge-observatory.candidate-inventory
purpose: Produce bounded, provenance-aware documentation candidates for owner review without editing source files.
invariants: The program is read-only and emits inspect/propose handles, never write instructions.
Heuristic artifact classes and portability signals are hypotheses, not authority.
Bounds, unavailable reads, private evidence, and unresolved owners remain explicit.
assumptions: The selected paths are bounded and readable through the knowledge-base review binding.
Candidates remain hypotheses until the owning scenario reviews them.

signals.candidates: Bounded source candidates and owner hints.

fixtures.note: Bounded owner fixture added during portfolio exercise; status is recorded honestly by the producer.
